dateNote: Report says 'its recent meeting' without a date. It approved April 13 minutes; the June 11 meeting approved 'May 11 regular meeting' minutes; calendar lists May 11, 2026 Regular.
headline: Tishomingo County School Board Covers Staffing, Technology, and Athletics
summary: The board approved personnel, field trips, fundraisers, grants, technology subscriptions, fuel bids, bid advertising for the press box and bleacher project and the purchase of Darktrace cybersecurity software. It approved a revised policy allowing eighth-grade athletes to practice with high school teams, with board member Jody McClung opposed.
publicComment: No one appeared for public comments.

personnel.note: Hires include a summer worker at $10/hour and several coaching and athletic-administration assignments; one employee resigned one position and was hired to another. other = 1 volunteer.

policy.item: Eighth-grade students who complete middle school sports seasons and have not committed to another middle school sport may practice and work out with high school teams on the high school coach's approval; amended in discussion so transportation is the district's responsibility.

superintendent: Superintendent Christie Holly informed the board that the district's Pre-K application had been submitted and confirmed as received.
